subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Test What You Ship
description: A quick win: understand Test What You Ship.

hook.text: Knight Capital tested everything—except the actual deployment process. That's where the $440 million bug lived.

buildup.text: Many teams test the code but not the deployment, configuration, or environment setup around it.

discovery.text: 'Test what you ship' means validating the exact artifact, config, and process that goes to production.

twist.text: A test that passes in staging but fails in production isn't a testing success—it's an environment failure.

climax.text: Infrastructure-as-code and deployment testing close the gap between 'it works on my machine' and production.

punchline.text: Don't just test the code. Test the ship.

quiz.question: What does 'test what you ship' mean?
options: Validate the exact artifact and process going to production
